about: ct1 hand decisions per classic team (2026-10-17): kit = 'modern' (style 0, the franchise's current kit), 'retail' (the franchise's historic spare: the retail 2004 kit, nfl2k5_historic_styles), an existing style index, or {prefer, fallback}; stadium = 'franchise' (the main roster's home venue row of that franchise). Noah 10/17: reuse an existing kit or stadium wherever the real one exists in the game. quality: match / close / stand-in. Uniform references: Gridiron Uniform Database season pages (reference only, never ship).

bears_2006.kit_note: The current Bears kit is the same design: navy over white pants at home, white over navy pants on the road (GUD 2006_CHI_3/1); only sock striping differs.

broncos_2015.kit_note: ek1's 2012-2023 Broncos kit (style 9: the 1997 design with the orange home jersey, navy side panels; road white with navy panels), GUD 2015_DEN_2/1. Without ek1's kit on the disc the franchise spare (navy home of the same design) is used.

browns_2017.kit_note: No 2015-2019 Browns kit exists (CLEVELAND chest wordmark, BROWNS pant leg). The current kit is the closest: new kit candidate.

browns_2020.kit_note: The 2020 redesign is the current kit (GUD 2020_CLE_H/C). The most-worn 2020 home look paired the brown jersey with orange pants; the kit's home pants are white.

buccaneers_2020.kit_note: 2020 return to the 1997-2013 look = current kit, GUD 2020_TB_C/B.

chargers_2006.kit_note: The 2002-2006 navy kit = the retail 2004 Chargers kit on the franchise spare, GUD 2006_SD_2/1.
chargers_2006.stadium_note: Qualcomm Stadium (2006): the Chargers' row is SoFi Stadium in the 2026 build; the team plays in the Chargers' row.

colts_2006.kit_note: Same design as the current kit, GUD 2006_IND_3/1.
colts_2006.stadium_note: RCA Dome (2006): its model is gone (the Colts' row is Lucas Oil Stadium); the team plays in the Colts' row.

colts_2014.kit_note: Same design as the current kit, GUD 2014_IND_2/1 (the 2020 numeral update is the only difference).

eagles_2017.kit_note: The 2017 era kit (a5k, style 14: midnight green over white pants both ways), what they wore in 11 of 18 games, GUD 2017_PHI_D.

giants_2016.kit_note: ek1's 2007-2011 Giants kit (style 9, the same road set Giants wore through 2016: road white with red numerals and grey pants, GUD 2016_NYG_4; home = the retail 18H8 blue over grey pants, while GUD 2016_NYG_3 shows white home pants). Without ek1's kit on the disc the retail 2004 look is used.

giants_2022.kit_note: Current kit = what they wore in 2022 (blue over white pants; white with red numerals on the road), GUD 2022_NYG_D/A.

lions_2008.kit_note: The 2003-2008 kit with black trim = the retail 2004 Lions kit, GUD 2008_DET_3/1.

packers_2010.kit_note: The retail 2004 Packers kit (same design), GUD 2010_GB_2/1.

packers_2011.kit_note: The retail 2004 Packers kit (same design), GUD 2011_GB_2/1.

panthers_2015.kit_note: The retail 2004 Panthers kit (black home, silver pants), GUD 2015_CAR_4/1.

patriots_2018.kit_note: The 2000-2019 design = the retail 2004 Patriots kit, GUD 2018_NE_C/A.

seahawks_2013.kit_note: The 2012 Nike design = current kit, GUD 2013_SEA_2/6.

steelers_2005.kit_note: The retail 2004 Steelers kit (same Reebok era), GUD 2005_PIT_3/1.

titans_2019.kit_note: No 2018-2023 Titans kit exists. Closest: the franchise's 1999-2017 kit (navy home, white road). The real 2019 look has a navy helmet, the 2018 numerals and sleeve sword stripes: new kit candidate.
